question: I cast Fork targeting Emerald Charm. When Fork resolves, is the copy of Emerald Charm red and does it keep the mode chosen for the original?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: the copy is red and has the same mode chosen for the original.
expected.answer: A player casts Fork, targeting an Emerald Charm. Fork reads, “Copy target instant or sorcery spell, except that the copy is red. You may choose new targets for the copy.” Emerald Charm is a modal green instant. When the Fork resolves, it puts a copy of the Emerald Charm on the stack except the copy is red, not green. The copy has the same mode that was chosen for the original Emerald Charm. It does not necessarily have the same target, but only because Fork allows choosing of new targets.
